searchText: When is JUMPFs arrival expected? I'd like more discussion about the best approach to inter-procedural optimizations before introducing an opcode to support just one of them. Hey everyone! Just catching up on the last couple of months. Is v1.1 just a naming to capture some proposed changes on top of the existing v1.0 specification? So the goal would still be to ship the first batch of EOF changes in Cancun? But hopefully with that revision on top of the current v1.0 specification? But the actual versioning used in those activated features would still be 1.0? We would not be shipping 1.0, and then 1.1? Is that correct? Just 1.0 And that hopefully including those changes over the current spec?

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content: When is JUMPFs arrival expected?  I'd like more discussion about the best approach to inter-procedural optimizations before introducing an opcode to support just one of them.

excerpts.author: bobsummerwill
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone!
Just catching up on the last couple of months.

Is v1.1 just a naming to capture some proposed changes on top of the existing v1.0 specification?

So the goal would still be to ship the first batch of EOF changes in Cancun?   But hopefully with that revision on top of the current v1.0 specification?    But the actual versioning used in those activated features would still be 1.0?

We would not be shipping 1.0, and then 1.1?   Is that correct?

excerpts.author: bobsummerwill
excerpts.content: And that hopefully including those changes over the current spec?
